import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem amc12b_2020_p22
  (S : Set ℝ)
  (hS: S = {x:ℝ | ∃ t, x = (2 ^ t - 3 * t) * t / 4 ^ t}) :
  IsGreatest S (1 / 12:ℝ) := by
  rw [hS]
  have hex : ∃ t : ℝ, (2 : ℝ) ^ t = 6 * t := by
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2 ^ t - 6 * t
    have hf : Continuous f := by
      dsimp [f]
      exact
        (Real.continuous_const_rpow (by norm_num)).sub
          (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (f 4) (f 6) := by
      norm_num [f]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_univ 4 6 hf hz
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    dsimp [f] at ht
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
  constructor
  · change ∃ t : ℝ, (1 / 12 : ℝ) =
      (2 ^ t - 3 * t) * t / 4 ^ t
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      subst t
      norm_num at ht
    have hp : (4 : ℝ) ^ t = ((2 : ℝ) ^ t) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
        Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
      ring
    rw [hp, ht]
    field_simp [ht0]
    ring
  · intro y hy
    change ∃ s : ℝ, y = (2 ^ s - 3 * s) * s / 4 ^ s at hy
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hp : (4 : ℝ) ^ s = ((2 : ℝ) ^ s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
        Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
      ring
    have hd : 0 < (4 : ℝ) ^ s :=
      Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).2
    rw [hp]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((2 : ℝ) ^ s - 6 * s)]
